title: Grateful Dead Live at Hollywood Palladium on 1972-09-09
lineage: MAR > R; sony ecm 22p's > sony tc-770; taped by Bruce Harvie; transfer: tdk 1800-sd 7" reel @ 3.75 ips, dolby b: technics rs-1506 > teac an-180 > benchmark adc1 24/96 > tascam hd-p2, adobe audition cs6 > cd wave > flac; transfer & seeded by Rob Berger
source: updated source info: aud 1st gen reel; Rob Bertrando's copy (via Michael Johan);

ai_review.summary: Beautiful, crystal‑clear recording that captures the high‑energy vibe of a September 1972 Grateful Dead show.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the pristine sound quality, likening it to the legendary 1969‑05‑03 sonics while noting the unmistakable energy of a September 1972 performance. The show is described as “perfect” and worthy of a desert island listen, indicating an outstanding musical experience despite the lack of specific song mentions.

ai_rating.rationale: Two consistent 5‑star reviews praise both the audio fidelity and the show’s energy, suggesting an excellent performance captured with high‑quality recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers call the sound "beautiful" and compare its sonics favorably to classic recordings (e.g., 1969‑05‑03), indicating a clear, well‑balanced mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers highlight the overall energy and feel of the show, noting it matches the spirited vibe typical of September 1972 concerts.
